title: docs(local): codify main operating cycle
body:
### Motivation
- Issue #234 records the owner's snapshot-first operating cycle after a main-session
  conflict repair serialized detached recovery work.

### Description
- Replace the obsolete long per-issue loop with short snapshot-driven turns and
  two-minute detached delegation.
- Order failed/attention recovery, labelled autofix or adjudication, stack propagation,
  and ready critical-packet dispatch; reserve merges for the daemon.
- Record the triggering incident and protocol evolution entry, including #27 live-worker
  reporting and #26 human-decision routing.

### Testing
- `scripts/install_git_hooks.sh --check`
- `git diff --check`
- Commit hook: staged whitespace passed; no statement-integrity files were staged.
- `local/bin/ci.sh 236` (all exact-head contexts passed, including its required
  locked build and blueprint-render gates)
- `local/bin/review.sh 236` (APPROVED, zero unresolved findings; prose skipped because
  the diff does not touch `blueprint/`)

---
Addresses #234
